summary: This bill authorizes the Department of Energy to provide financial assistance to states and Indian Tribes to establish or expand "flex-tech energy programs" that offer technical and financial aid to manufacturers for energy studies and the implementation of energy-saving and emissions-reducing measures.

scores.thoughts: The bill explicitly authorizes appropriations of $100,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2026 through 2030 to provide financial assistance for flex-tech energy programs. This directly increases government spending.

The bill aims to enhance manufacturing competitiveness through flex-tech energy programs, which include evaluations and implementation of measures for energy efficiency, greenhouse gas emissions mitigation, and sustainability planning. This directly promotes environmental protection by reducing emissions and improving energy use.

The bill creates a new federal grant program and authorizes $100 million annually for FY2026–2030 ($500 million total) with no revenue offsets, spending cuts, or deficit-reduction measures. This new discretionary spending is the central purpose of the legislation.
